bullets.text: A youth undergoing treatment at a drug rehabilitation center in Mangadu was allegedly killed by the staff, prompting police investigation.
A security guard died of burn injuries after a high-tension power cable snapped and fell on him near Avadi in Thirunindravur.
Heavy overnight rainfall averaging 3.42 cm lashed Chennai and caused water stagnation across multiple neighborhoods.
AI, IT and Digital Services Minister R. Kumar inspected ongoing northeast monsoon preparedness works in the Adyar zone.
Construction of the Greater Chennai Corporation food court on Indira Nagar 3rd Avenue in Adyar is only 40 percent complete and expected in 2027.
Residents of Tower of Adyar Apartment on LB Road are clearing parking lots on October 25 for a Joy of Giving collection drive.
The IMD has issued an orange alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall in districts including Thiruvallur.
The Indian Navy inducted the indigenously built warship INS Samarthak, manufactured in Kattupalli, Thiruvallur district.
Avadi City Police Cyber Crime Wing arrested a Delhi man for a 1.90 crore rupee online boss scam targeting a private company.
CapitaLand inaugurated a new data centre in Ambattur, Chennai, with the Chief Minister in attendance.
Infosys plans to hire 20,000 fresh graduates as artificial intelligence transforms the IT sector.
The DMK demanded the removal of the Chief Election Commissioner and criticized the Congress and TVK leadership over the SIR issue.
The government has cancelled a tender initiated during the previous DMK administration for roadside amenity centers across seven districts.

stories.snippet: இன்னும் எத்தனை லியோ தாஸ்.. சொந்தக் கட்சியிலேயே போதை மாபியா.. விஜயை விளாசியெடுத்த ஸ்டாலின்! தாசில்தார் மூலமாகக் கம்யூனிஸ்டுகளைக் கணக்கெடுப்பதற்கு பதிலாக, மாவட்டத்துக்கு மாவட்டம் இப்படி எத்தனை லியோதாஸ்களும், பவுடர்…
